title: RInstallations
description:
This defines the top-level object that describes the data returned by the server.
It contains information about each installation of R that is known.

installations.description:
The array of information about Posit Connect's R
installations.

RInstallation.description: This defines the information provided by the server about a single installation of R.

version.description: The version number of this R installation.

cluster_name.description:
The cluster that contains this R installation.
A value of `Local` indicates that the R installation is local to the Posit
Connect server.

image_name.description:
The image that contains this R installation.
A value of `Local` indicates that the R installation is local to the Posit
Connect server.
